data.description:
Brandon's task; agents release it. Mark it done when the clips are committed; the real-voice bench task waits on it.

Context: the testdata/ clips are macOS `say` voices. The top models all land around 0.5 % WER on them, so they can't tell the models apart (DESIGN.md "Next steps" 4).

- Record 5–10 clips of your own voice, 16 kHz mono WAV: short commands, numbers and names, a 2–3 minute ramble with self-corrections ("Tuesday, no, Wednesday"), and one with long pauses.
- Add each to testdata/ with a row in testdata/manifest.tsv (id, speaker, category, the transcript exactly as it should be pasted).
- Decide whether your voice clips go in the public repo.
data.title: Hands-on: record a few real-voice clips for benching
